_comment: Default non-secret options. Overlay with appsettings.Development.json / appsettings.Windows.json (or appsettings.{Environment}.json) — later layers bind these sections from the embedded stream.

Persistence._comment: DefaultRecipients are the prototype's first-run payee list (public ABA test routing, not customer secrets). They stay in this base file — not a Development/test overlay — because the MAUI host builds configuration without an environment overlay and the E2E seed contract (ConfigSeedPayeeIdTests) asserts these stable ids here. Move to an overlay only when a production backend supplies real payees.

SyncScheduler._comment: Omit MaxConcurrency (0 = unset) so Resolve() uses half the processor count, clamped 1–8.
